prompt:
Editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, hand-painted Japanese book-illustration feel: delicate dark pencil contours, soft organic painted washes, subtle paper texture, warm ivory paper tones. Palette: cream, warm sand, charcoal gray, muted sage green, warm timber wood, muted brick-red accents. Landscape 4:3 composition, FULL-BLEED: the painting fills the whole canvas edge to edge, with NO frame, NO border line, NO mat and NO paper margin around it.
Characters, when present: young male student = slightly messy short dark hair, cream long-sleeved shirt, charcoal trousers, black backpack; young woman = chin-length dark bob with bangs, cream cardigan over muted brick-red top, charcoal skirt, small brown shoulder bag.

Subject: a straight-on front view of one simple wooden desk standing in the middle of a calm, uncluttered room, placed so every position relation reads at a glance: an open cardboard box sits ON TOP of the desk with one red apple visible INSIDE the box; a tabby cat sleeps UNDER the desk; a wooden chair stands IN FRONT of the desk, turned slightly so the desk stays visible; a window on the wall BEHIND the desk; a tall potted plant stands to the LEFT of the desk and a low bookshelf to the RIGHT, so the desk is clearly BETWEEN the plant and the bookshelf. No people. Plain floor and wall, generous space between the objects, nothing overlapping. Keep every object inside the central 4:3 area of the canvas.
Keep the main subject in the central area so the image survives cropping to a thumbnail.

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:
- Absolutely NO text, letters, kanji, kana, numbers or words anywhere: signs, boards, labels and screens stay completely blank.
- Clock faces have NO digits and NO Roman numerals.
- Hand-painted watercolor gouache look, NOT 3D, NOT CGI, NOT glossy vector, NOT photo.

suggestedAlt.vi: Chiếc bàn ở giữa phòng: trên bàn có hộp đựng quả táo, dưới gầm có con mèo ngủ, phía trước là ghế, phía sau là cửa sổ, bên trái là chậu cây và bên phải là giá sách.

caption.vi: Trong hình: hộp ở 上[うえ] (trên) bàn, quả táo ở 中[なか] (trong) hộp, con mèo ở 下[した] (dưới) bàn, ghế ở 前[まえ] (trước) bàn, cửa sổ ở 後[うし]ろ (sau) bàn; chậu cây ở 左[ひだり] (bên trái), giá sách ở 右[みぎ] (bên phải), nên bàn ở 間[あいだ] (giữa) chậu cây và giá sách.
